said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
When I was deployed to Afghanistan, I met dozens of locals who put their own lives on the line to help keep us safe.

In return, our country promised them refuge.

That’s why I signed onto a discharge petition to force a vote on extending their protected status here in the United https://t.co/TvVZXZ2YXl

If you were wounded in combat, you’ve already paid a price for this country. Washington shouldn’t make you pay it twice.

That’s the principle behind the Major Richard Star Act, which I helped pass this week alongside my colleagues in the House.

This bill puts an average of https://t.co/RxYZIqinBY

To my fellow veterans: Thank you for your service to our country.

Maine has one of the highest shares of veterans in the nation. When I’m home in Lewiston, I'm proud of how easy it is to be surrounded by other men and women who answered the call to serve.

There is unique honor https://t.co/DkEtTMKg1G

Four times, the people of Maine’s 2nd District chose me to represent them in Congress. I know what an incredible honor it is to earn their trust. For their faith, I will always be thankful.

I also know a thing or two about winning in tough circumstances. So, I know you have to tip your hat to Paul LePage for winning in the midst of this Blue Tsunami. I stand ready to work with him to ensure the smooth transition that Mainers deserve.
Find your polling place here: https://t.co/trtOBhC76s

Drive, walk, bike, or take a boat — however you get to the polls today, make sure you vote!

Maine has same-day voter registration and one of the highest voter participation rates in the country. If you haven’t voted already, don’t be left out. https://t.co/MSTpyYFbpn

Hot take: The spookiest thing this Halloween is our $40 trillion dollars in national debt.

Read about the bill I’m leading with my fellow Blue Dogs to fix our broken budget process so we don’t have to fear the future:

https://t.co/d1Vy8x7kRr https://t.co/54tUFQdi1r

For 250 years, we’ve built our naval fleet right here in America at shipyards like Bath Iron Works — providing for our defense and reaping the benefits of jobs and innovation.

Now, the Trump administration wants to buy ships made by foreign labor in foreign shipyards, https://t.co/a3JKkH1wm1

Good news: Momentum is building for protecting Maine’s lobstermen and our fishing heritage. 

I’m grateful for the partnership of @SenatorCollins, @SenAngusKing and @SenTedCruz in getting my bill a markup in the Senate Commerce Committee. https://t.co/2SMP4BoqK9

Three years ago today, 18 Mainers were killed and 13 more injured in the deadliest shooting in our state’s history.

It shook our community, our state and the entire nation. While time has passed, the painful sense of loss remains, especially for the families and friends who lost loved ones and for the victims who still carry the scars of that awful day.

But while the grief remains, my pride in my hometown does too. In the days and weeks after the shooting, Mainers showed up for one another. In the midst of the crisis, we had each other’s backs.

Today, Izzy and I are keeping the victims and their loved ones in our prayers. We will never forget the horror of October 25, 2023. But as we were then, we will remain: Lewiston Strong.

Our first responders do so much for our communities, but the job just keeps getting harder.

Maine’s population is aging, and that includes our first responders. If we don’t do something, we’re heading for a workforce crisis that could spiral into a healthcare crisis. We can’t afford that outcome.

Along with a bipartisan group of colleagues, I’ve proposed a number of solutions, including the PARA-EMT Act, which would establish a grant program to recruit, train and retain paramedics and EMTs in rural areas. It would also help veterans transition into civilian EMT careers.

We need solutions to keep Mainers safe in the future. Congress should act.

While Maine’s home heating prices have risen by 80% year to year, LIHEAP’s funding has increased by less than one percent.

With winter on the horizon, I’m urging Congress to plug the gap as soon as possible so that Mainers don’t have to face the cold alone.

I’ve joined @RepChrisPappas to request a supplemental $3 billion for LIHEAP, on top of the $4 billion already appropriated.

Every tribe in the nation is able to access federal programs and resources specifically intended for them — except Maine’s.

While we celebrate Maine’s tribes today, let us also recommit to the fight for sovereignty for our tribal neighbors. https://t.co/nyL4qPtbSf
Learn more about the comprehensive reforms in our bill here: https://t.co/NBBXbKao9Q
I’m proud our bill has the support of the @HouseBlueDogs and the support of @CRFB, @ConcordAction, @PPI and the Peterson Solutions Fund.

Along with @RepMGP and @RepAdamGrayCA, I just introduced the Congressional Budget Reform Act. It will:

💰Tackle the out-of-control debt
🚫End government shutdowns
⚖️Strengthen checks and balances and bipartisanship
🗓️Make Congress pass budgets on-time

Americans deserve fiscal stability and responsible government, but the nation’s skyrocketing debt and ailing fiscal health are making life more expensive for families and threatening the prosperity of future generations.

It’s time to do something about it. 🧵
More info here: https://t.co/OZFpBsICEr

Mainers: Today marks the first day of early voting in our state.

From now until October 29, you can vote via mail or in person.

Simply head to the link below to learn how to make your voice heard this election year. https://t.co/GaLiujqHq4

For as long as I've been in Congress, I have opposed efforts to cut LIHEAP and worked across the aisle to ensure adequate home heating assistance is available to keep Mainers warm in our long, cold winters. 

With heating oil prices at record highs, Mainers are feeling the pinch like never before. I will support any effort to increase LIHEAP funding in a supplemental appropriation this year.
When we get back to Washington in November, I look forward to working with my colleagues to get this bill across the finish line and to the President’s desk.

The BAAJA will also create more certainty in the energy industry. As I fought for in the House, this deal includes a provision to prevent any president from pulling the plug on projects approved under their predecessor.

Like my SPEED Act, which we passed in the House last year, this bill will reduce the endless litigation that makes it more expensive to build, while protecting locals’ ability to raise timely, reasonable objections.

This bill also acts as a bulwark against instability and pursues an all-of-the-above approach to energy production — allowing for more production of cheap,  clean domestic energy for American families.

Between 2024 and 2025, Mainers saw the largest spike in their electricity prices of any state in the country.

We are using more energy than ever, but new energy projects get stuck in limbo for years. This bill cuts red tape, increases production and lowers costs for ratepayers.

To cut electricity costs, we need to generate more domestic energy & build transmission lines to get it to homes & businesses. The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 builds on my bill with @repwesterman to get shovels in the ground.

The Senate should pass it🧵
When we get back to Washington in November, I look forward to working with my colleagues to get this bill across the finish line and to the President’s desk.

The BAAJA will also create more certainty in the energy industry. As I fought for in the House, this deal includes a provision to prevent any president from pulling the plug on projects approved under their predecessor.

Like my SPEED Act, which we passed in the House last year, this bill will reduce the endless litigation that makes it more expensive to build, while protecting locals’ ability to raise timely, reasonable objections.
This bill acts as a bulwark against instability and pursues an all-of-the-above approach to energy production — allowing for more production of domestic, cheap & clean energy for American families.

Between 2024 and 2025, Mainers saw the largest spike in their electricity prices of any state in the country.

We are using more energy than ever, but new energy projects get stuck in limbo for years. This bill cuts red tape, increases production and lowers costs for ratepayers.
@RepJackBergman @Congressman_JVD @RepDonDavis Read more about this bill here: https://t.co/TFAr9L0zBb

Dental care is healthcare. Plain and simple.

Yet those who served our country, and now live in remote or rural communities, often struggle to access reliable dental care.

That’s why I’m teaming up with @RepJackBergman, @Congressman_JVD and @RepDonDavis to help vets who aren’t able to afford or access a dentist get the care they need.

I’m confident this first step will do a lot of good.

Thrilled to see nurses at my local hospital, Central Maine Medical Center, vote to unionize.

Nurses banding together won’t just mean better working conditions for them, but better care for our community.

Unfortunately, 20 nurses were fired or suspended during the union drive. As @chelliepingree and I wrote to Prime Healthcare, the hospital's owner, anti-union retaliation and intimidation are illegal.

I call on hospital management to swiftly recognize the union and bargain in good faith. I’m heartened to know that now that they’ve won their union, nurses will begin organizing not only for themselves and their patients, but to reinstate any workers wrongfully punished for exercising their rights.

Congratulations again to the nurses in Lewiston on winning their union!
